items.hook: A Walking Tour of the Shambles (2002), written by Neil Gaiman and Gene Wolfe, is a novel in the form of a tour guide concerning a fictional part of Chicago called 'The Shambles'.
items.body: It guides the reader through such non-existent landmarks as The House of Clocks, Cereal House, and Gavagan's Irish Saloon. One of those things you can't un-know.
